title: Provenance
description: Who made one change and when: the actor the server signed in, the model the actor said it runs as, and the time the server recorded. The actor comes from sign-in, never from the request's arguments; the model is the caller's own statement. Section 3.1 of the protocol.

model.description: The model the actor named, such as claude-opus-5-5; null when it named none.
